title: Metadata extract mode
description: Choose the metadata extraction style for the whole system. After digitization and dossier merge, every dossier follows the selected mode.

modeHelp.old: Dossiers will be extracted using the judgment-enforcement metadata template.
modeHelp.tt05: Dossiers will be extracted using the Circular 05 metadata template.
modeHelp.pvep: Dossiers will be extracted using the PVEP metadata template.
modeHelp.tuyen-quang: Dossiers will be extracted using the Tuyen Quang metadata template.
modeHelp.off: The system will not extract automatically. Trigger manually when needed.

errors.loadFailed: Failed to load metadata extract settings

readOnlyHint: You have read-only access. Update permission is required to change the mode.

quota.title: Extract page quota
quota.description: Total pages extracted across the system. Renew by applying a vendor-signed license file.
quota.lowRemaining: Quota is almost gone. Batches with more pages than remaining cannot be uploaded.
quota.uploadExceeded: Not enough extract page quota: upload batch has {{pages}} pages, only {{remaining}} remaining. Apply another license or reduce page count.
quota.uploadExceededGeneric: Not enough extract page quota. Apply another license or reduce page count.
quota.noLicense: No license applied. Upload a .lic file to set the page cap.
quota.stopped: Quota reached — Kafka extract routing is stopped.
